sheets.prompt:
Create a square high-resolution painted dark fantasy bestiary portrait CONTACT SHEET, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal SQUARE edge-to-edge tiles. Request 1536x1536 resolution or largest square available. Each tile is an independent finished detailed original illustration, with no borders, gutters, lettering, numbers, captions, logos or UI. Hard straight tile boundaries at exact equal fractions of the full image. Every creature stays entirely inside its own tile, no overlap. Close portrait composition; face and upper body for humanoids; characteristic head and body for animals/monsters. Faces large and readable. Hand-painted realistic fantasy cover art, rich fine brushwork, weathered tangible materials, warm amber torchlight from left, deep blue-violet cavern shadows, atmospheric dungeon setting behind each subject. Dramatic ominous grounded mood. No pixel art, no sprites, no cartoon style. Distinct species anatomy and silhouettes. Keep the essential eyes, ears, horns, weapons and identifying details inside each square with a little room around them. Read LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM, use this EXACT order:
Row 1, column 1: Giant Rat: huge brown sewer rat, wet whiskers, yellow incisors.
Row 1, column 2: Cave Bat: cave bat with huge ears, leathery wings.
Row 1, column 3: Green Slime: translucent emerald slime, bubbling jelly, no humanoid face.
Row 1, column 4: Cave Spider: violet-black cave spider with eight legs and clustered red eyes.
Row 2, column 1: Goblin: small olive goblin with pointed ears, scrap leather and knife.
Row 2, column 2: Skeleton: animated skeleton with rusty sword and remnants of mail.
Row 2, column 3: Zombie: shambling pale dead human, ragged clothes.
Row 2, column 4: Orc: heavy green-grey orc with short tusks, iron axe and leather.
Row 3, column 1: Ghoul: gaunt grey-green grave ghoul with many teeth and clawed hands.
Row 3, column 2: Wraith: spectral violet figure in ragged hood, cold eyes in darkness.
Row 3, column 3: Ogre: massive brutish ogre with blunt features, rough hide and club.
Row 3, column 4: Troll: green mossy troll with long nose and wild coarse hair.
Row 4, column 1: Minotaur: bull-headed warrior with broad horns and battle axe.
Row 4, column 2: Kobold Trapper: small rusty red reptilian trapper, dart, leather snares.
Row 4, column 3: Goblin Archer: olive goblin archer with bow and quiver.
Row 4, column 4: Basilisk: low reptilian basilisk with amber petrifying eyes and stony scales.
